    The path algebra of the statement #

    Basic relations in kQ (Statement.FinQuiver.PathAlgebra) and the fact that the elements e_x · w (a vertex idempotent times a word of arrows) span kQ (span_vertex_mul_word). Algebra homomorphisms out of kQ are built with liftOfRelations from images of the generators satisfying the defining relations.

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Statement.FinQuiver.vertex_mul_vertex (k : Type u_1) [Field k] (Q : FinQuiver) (v w : Q.V) :
    vertex k Q v * vertex k Q w = if v = w then vertex k Q v else 0
    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Statement.FinQuiver.sum_vertex (k : Type u_1) [Field k] (Q : FinQuiver) :
    ∑ v : Q.V, vertex k Q v = 1
    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Statement.FinQuiver.vertex_src_mul_arrow (k : Type u_1) [Field k] (Q : FinQuiver) (a : Q.A) :
    vertex k Q (Q.src a) * arrow k Q a = arrow k Q a
    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Statement.FinQuiver.arrow_mul_vertex_tgt (k : Type u_1) [Field k] (Q : FinQuiver) (a : Q.A) :
    arrow k Q a * vertex k Q (Q.tgt a) = arrow k Q a
    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Statement.FinQuiver.word_append (k : Type u_1) [Field k] (Q : FinQuiver) (l₁ l₂ : List Q.A) :
    word k Q (l₁ ++ l₂) = word k Q l₁ * word k Q l₂
    source
    @[simp]
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Statement.FinQuiver.word_nil (k : Type u_1) [Field k] (Q : FinQuiver) :
    word k Q [] = 1
    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Statement.FinQuiver.word_cons (k : Type u_1) [Field k] (Q : FinQuiver) (a : Q.A) (l : List Q.A) :
    word k Q (a :: l) = arrow k Q a * word k Q l
